🚨 TCS Data Engineer Interviews Are No Longer About “Define ETL.” 🚨
They are testing whether you can design REAL enterprise-scale data pipelines. ⚡
This Round-1 TCS Data Engineer interview set is packed with the exact scenario-based questions candidates are facing in 2026.
And honestly…
 These are the kinds of questions that separate:
❌ Tutorial-based preparation
 from
 ✅ Real engineering thinking
Some major topics covered in this round 👇
🔥 Multi-source Data Ingestion
 🔥 Incremental Load Design
 🔥 SCD Type 1 & Type 2
 🔥 Real-Time Streaming Pipelines
 🔥 Data Quality Frameworks
 🔥 Spark Optimization

 🔥 Data Lake vs Data Warehouse
 🔥 End-to-End Business Case Scenarios
What’s interesting is HOW interviewers evaluate answers.
